items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Since then, Katherine Dunham has...the governments before the Duvaliers, I think, gave over a piece of land to be a landlord over some land there.

ctx.x: I don't know. I don't remember his last name. And a guitar player by the name of Harry Holt, and Joe Vitas(?) was the tenor player. That was the band. We did a little stint down there, and became very friendly with one of the sons of one of the ex-Presidents, Pierre Bernot(?), who was also a pianist, and later became a delegate to the United Nations from Haiti. We resided at his home in Pichardeau(?), we used to visit regularly.

In those times, that country was beautiful. There's no doubt about it. Since then, Katherine Dunham has...the governments before the Duvaliers, I think, gave over a piece of land to be a landlord over some land there. But anyhow, it was a beautiful country. It is a beautiful country. And it's just too bad that this country doesn't help it. The injustice...

Now, I don't want to go into this, it isn't my area, but I was also in Cuba during the War. I represented the first all so-called Black unit of the USO, the first experimental... Primarily I was in... I was also in Cafe
